preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) representing the number of strings.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) > 0 and all(c.islower() for c in line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the next n lines contains a non-empty string consisting only of lowercase Latin letters.
The sum of the lengths of all strings does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the size of the largest subgroup where all strings are suffixes of a common string t.

postconditions.expression: all(si.endswith(t) for si in subgroup) and len(subgroup) == int(stdout) and len(subgroup) >= len(s) for s in [stdin.splitlines()[1:]] for subgroup in [s] if all(si.endswith(t) for si in subgroup) for t in [min(subgroup, key=len)]
postconditions.description: The output integer is the maximum size of a subgroup where all strings are suffixes of the shortest string in the subgroup.
